title: Interpretable but Fragile? Robustness of Concept Bottlenecks under Geometric-Semantic Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2609.38625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to provide interpretable intermediate representations, yet how such bottlenecks affect robustness remains unclear, with existing studies reporting mixed and sometimes contradictory findings. We argue that these discrepancies arise from conflating different robustness notions and perturbation regimes, rather than from fundamental disagreements about CBMs themselves. To disentangle these factors, we introduce a generator-based evaluation framework that enables controlled comparisons between standard classifiers and CBMs under two distinct perturbation types: continuous geometric perturbations in latent space and discrete semantic interventions in concept space. Within this framework, we evaluate robustness both empirically, via prediction and concept-level sensitivity metrics, and certifiably, using randomized smoothing in latent and concept spaces. translated_title: 可解释但脆弱？概念瓶颈模型在几何-语义扰动下的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）旨在提供可解释的中间表示，然而此类瓶颈如何影响模型鲁棒性仍不明确，现有研究报告的结果不一致，有时甚至相互矛盾。我们认为，这些分歧源于将不同的鲁棒性概念与扰动模式混为一谈，而非对概念瓶颈模型本身存在根本性分歧。为厘清这些因素，我们提出了一个基于生成器的评估框架，使标准分类器与概念瓶颈模型能够在两类截然不同的扰动下进行受控比较：潜空间中的连续几何扰动与概念空间中的离散语义干预。在该框架内，我们一方面通过预测与概念级敏感性指标对鲁棒性进行经验性评估，另一方面利用潜空间与概念空间中的随机平滑进行可认证的鲁棒性评估。在一系列实验中，我们调和了此前……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于生成器的统一评估框架，首次将潜空间中的连续几何扰动与概念空间中的离散语义干预区分开来，从经验性与可认证两个层面系统比较概念瓶颈模型与标准分类器的鲁棒性，从而调和了此前相互矛盾的研究结论。
en_tdlr: It introduces a generator-based evaluation framework that disentangles continuous geometric perturbations in latent space from discrete semantic interventions in concept space, systematically assessing the robustness of Concept Bottleneck Models both empirically and certifiably, thereby reconciling previously contradictory findings.
